title: Radial Stitch on a 40 mm circle at density 5
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Radial Stitch (round 15, #1050): lines in pairs sewn in to an apex and back out to the outline points the pairs share, 1/density apart at the outline at every density (0.2-7.0 line/mm); one pair in K reaches the centre, K the multiple of 3 nearest 22.5 degrees of pairs (about 16 a turn), the others stop long (4-6 mm) or short (1.5-3 mm) in turn; 2,0 mm run stitches. The centre no more crowded than PE-DESIGN's (#461). Counts within 4 %, bounds and the mean stitch length.

references.make: Opened round 4's circle40-concentric.pes (Shapes > Circle dragged (30,30)-(70,70) mm, 40,00 x 40,00; Concentric Circle density 2,0, run pitch 2,0; line Not Sewn; 800 EMBROIDERY RED; Hoop Size 100 x 100 mm), switched the region to Radial Stitch (the pane shows only Density and Run pitch, 2,0 and 2,0), Density 5,0; Save As PES (default type, Ver.11.0). Status bar 40,00 x 40,00 mm, Stitches = 5717.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11.50's file: 5717 stitches; OpenStitch within 4 % (the outward line's stitches start nearer the apex in PE-DESIGN's)

PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, measured the same way: 301 distinct needle points within 3 mm of the centre at density 5. The centre may be no more crowded than PE-DESIGN's (#461: thread breaks and the fabric is cut where the lines converge).
PE-DESIGN 11.50's file, measured the same way: 301 pairs of those needle points under 0.25 mm apart at density 5; no more here (#461).
